name: RUNAWAYS [beta]
desc:
You've been found guilty of crimes you definitely committed. Your lawyer's advice? Get out of the country before the police catch you!

💎 Rob anything in your way
💰 Pawn your loot for cash
🧨 Blow open vaults and safes
🚔 Outrun the police
🌎 Make your way to the border!

Like and favorite the game, it motivates us to push better updates!

[Controls]
Click/Touch - Punch (or tool action)
E - Equip (or drag action)
X - Drop tool
R - Reload gun
Q - Attach
F - Inventory
C - Crouch / Slide
